items.lede: France has linked October cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration systems at more than 700 supermarkets and other retail locations to Iranian state-backed hackers, saying the attacks caused food losses and sparked at least 15 fires. [...]
items.title: France blames Iranian hackers for supermarket attacks that sparked fires

items.lede: France's foreign minister blamed Iran for launching at least two waves of cyberattacks targeting industrial refrigerated and freezer units across France and wider Europe.
items.title: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
